summary: The Harbor-Antrieb execution bridge failed before every command could reach node1. Consequently, the LVM work and mandatory restart protocol could not be performed or verified.
actions_performed: Attempted storage and LVM inspection on node1.
Retried with minimal identity, no-op, and hostname commands.
Made no changes because managed-node access was unavailable.

evidence.requirement: Logical volume mounted at /srv/data and grown online to at least 2 GB with contents intact
evidence.summary: No evidence was captured because all permitted exec calls failed with backend `ExceptionGroup` before returning command output or an evidence ID.
The healthy baseline, safe restart, changed boot identity, and recovered state could not be captured because node1 was unreachable through the required control surface.
